MikroTik hAP Lite (RB941-2nD) – Compact & Affordable Wireless Router

Best Home & Small Office WiFi Router with 2.4GHz Wireless & 4 LAN Ports

The MikroTik hAP Lite (RB941-2nD) is an affordable and reliable home and small office router, offering strong wireless connectivity and essential networking features in a compact form factor. Equipped with a 650MHz CPU, 32MB RAM, and 16MB FLASH storage, it ensures smooth performance for everyday internet usage.


With 4 x 10/100 Mbps LAN ports and built-in 2.4GHz WiFi (802.11b/g/n, 2x2 MIMO), the hAP Lite is perfect for home users, small offices, and businesses needing a cost-effective yet powerful networking solution.


Key Features

  • Compact & Powerful – 650MHz CPU for reliable performance in home & small office environments.
  • Wireless Connectivity – Built-in 2.4GHz 802.11b/g/n WiFi with integrated dual-chain antennas for stable and high-speed wireless networking.
  • Multiple LAN Connections – 4 x Fast Ethernet LAN ports for wired connectivity to PCs, smart TVs, and other devices.
  • RouterOS L4 License – Advanced networking features including firewall, bandwidth management, and VPN support.
  • Energy-Efficient Design – Low power consumption, powered via USB adapter for easy installation anywhere.
  • Compact & Lightweight – Perfect for home, apartment, dormitory, or small office use.
  • International Version – Designed for global compatibility and seamless operation.
  • Made by MikroTik – Trusted Latvian networking technology, manufactured in Latvia, Lithuania, or China.
  • 12-Month Limited Warranty – Ensuring peace of mind and reliability.


Technical Specifications

  • Brand: MikroTik
  • Model: hAP Lite (RB941-2nD)
  • CPU: 650MHz
  • RAM: 32MB
  • Storage: 16MB FLASH
  • Ethernet Ports: 4 x 10/100 Mbps LAN Ports
  • WiFi: Built-in 2.4GHz 802.11b/g/n, 2x2 MIMO
  • Antenna: Integrated
  • Operating System: RouterOS L4
  • Power Supply: USB Adapter
  • Enclosure: Desktop Case
  • Manufacturing Origin: Latvia, Lithuania, or China
  • Warranty: 12-Month Limited Warranty

Ideal Applications

  • Home Networking – Provides stable WiFi & wired connections for everyday use.
  • Small Offices & Startups – Ideal for cost-effective, reliable internet access.
  • Apartments & Dorms – Compact design fits anywhere while delivering strong WiFi performance.
  • IoT & Smart Homes – Connect smart devices, security cameras, and home automation systems effortlessly.
  • Travel & Temporary Networks – Lightweight and USB-powered for easy portability.


Why Choose MikroTik hAP Lite?

  • Affordable & Feature-Rich – Perfect balance of cost, performance, and reliability.
  • Compact & Lightweight – Small size makes it easy to place anywhere.
  • Fast & Stable Wireless – 2.4GHz WiFi with dual-chain antennas for strong signal coverage.
  • MikroTik Reliability – Advanced RouterOS features ensure secure & stable networking.
